title: FROST LINE
style: Boom bap revival, modern crate-rooted and confident, hard dusty sampled drums with a punchy kick and snap snare under swung hats, warm prominent played or filtered sampled bass, chopped soul and jazz loops with warm keys and tasteful horn stabs, vinyl dust and crackle retained, confident mid-register multi-syllabic delivery with DJ scratch hooks and bar-end doubles, warm punchy mix. A dusty loop with crackle opens. Hard drums snap in. Verses ride confident. A DJ scratch answers the hook. The loop strips to sampled source for the last four bars. 85-95 BPM, E minor. one narrator, low and unhurried, close to the mic, more tired than angry
exclude: trap hats, autotune, sub-bass drops, EDM synths, no sampling
lyrics:
[Intro]
Forty degrees at the mailbox is the first honest number of the season
Everything I left unfixed in October bills me in January

[Verse 1]
Cold came through the truck door, said it plain, no rehearsal
Frost on the windshield spelling out my whole dispersal
Piled up the summer like the summer owed me something back
Dropped a hundred names into a bucket that I never packed
Mailbox full of paper and none of it was mine to open
Every favor that I called in came back smaller than I had spoken
Old dog on the porch like the weather is a rumor
My father in my head: winter sorts the men from the fewer

[Hook] [Dusty Drums] [Scratch Hook]
Frost line running through the whole of me
(through the whole of me)
Line it up and see what's left standing when it's cold
(frost line running through)

[Verse 2]
Round here the first freeze is honest as a poor man's ledger
Pick a vice or pick a habit, either way you lose the weather
Heater with an attitude and half a cord of wood
A friend I do not call because he'd ask me if I'm good
Snow tires in the barn and a woman on the fence
Both of them will tell me what they think of me in tense
Keep a page of names I swore I'd never let go under
Every winter takes a few and never leaves a number

[Hook] [Dusty Drums] [Scratch Hook]
Frost line running through the whole of me
(through the whole of me)
Line it up and see what's left standing when it's cold
(frost line running through)

[Bridge]
Nothing frozen ever dies, it just waits around for thaw
And everything I buried here is standing where I saw

[Verse 3]
Winter does not hate you, it just asks you what you're holding
April does not know you, it just finds out where you're going
I have been warm on less than this and colder in a crowd
So I'll take the wood I split myself and let it burn loud

[Hook] [Dusty Drums] [Scratch Hook]
Frost line running through the whole of me
(through the whole of me)
Line it up and see what's left standing when it's cold
(frost line running through)
